newsitem.title: USA: Barefoot stake held by Yacktman group.
newsitem.headline: Barefoot stake held by Yacktman group.

text.p: A group led by Donald Yacktman, president and owner of Yacktman Asset Management Co, said on Monday it held a 14.9059 percent stake in Barefoot Inc or 2,164,300 common shares.
In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said it bought 100,400 common shares in the past 60 days at prices ranging from $10.25 to $11.125 per share.
The group said it bought shares in the Washington, Ohio professional lawn-care service company for investment purposes.
